EC1: - modified Rankin scale > 4 at the time of enrollment (severe disability)
EC2: - life expectancy < 1 year [OR] or terminal illness,
EC5: - symptomatic flow limiting carotid stenosis [NOT] without plan for intervention
EC6: - urine toxicology positive for cocaine [OR] or methamphetamine [OR] or recent use
EC7: - long-term BP goal ≥ 130/80 mmHg according to clinical team
